quote.text: No lo hagas, si no conviene; no lo digas si no es verdad.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Act only when it truly benefits your family; let your decisions be guided by love and practicality rather than impulse.
    • Speak with honesty and consistency—your words form the foundation of trust and serve as a model for your children’s character.
  • Leadership:
    • Embrace actions that align with the greater good of your team or community; avoid measures driven by convenience that may undermine your integrity.
    • Hold your communication to the highest standard—lead by example through truthfulness, ensuring your decisions inspire genuine commitment.
  • Product Management:
    • Initiate projects or features only when they add clear value; let practical benefits dictate your strategy rather than unnecessary complexity or trend.
    • Communicate product insights with clarity and truthfulness; honest feedback fosters trust with your stakeholders and guides better decision-making.
